QuestInfo.name: Stranded 2
QuestInfo.0: You tried to roast the Starfish Meat yourself, but there's no more Kindling. Where can you get more? Ask Cutter.
QuestInfo.1:
Cutter told you that you can get more Kindling from Oak Barrels that were swept ashore. To find them, go through the portal on the top right of the cannon. Get some #t4032980#s by destroying Oak Barrels with your #bRegular Attack#k.

#i4032980##t4032980#  #b#c4032980#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: After obtaining plenty of #t4032980#s, you asked Cutter about the small island that you saw on your way back. Cutter finally told you that there might be a way to escape, and the key is on that small island. However, he also said that it probably wouldn't work...

0.0: Okay, so, we are without kindling to start a fire. I should have checked that earlier, but, ehh, whatever. Go get us some kindling, okay? Take #bthe portal on the top right of the cannon#k.\r\n#L0##bKindling? Where am I gonna find kindling in a place like this?#l\n#k
0.1: Well, if you stop fussing, I'll tell you. There are a mess of Oak Barrels washed up over there. The wood in the barrels is treated to stay dry, so it burns nicely. So, go smash 'em up and bring me the #b#t4032980#s#k you get from them. Makes sense, right? Good! Now go! This starfish ain't gonna roast itself! That would be pretty nice, though...

yes.0: To obtain #t4032980#, whack the Oak Barrels with your #bRegular Attack#k. You bring me enough #b#t4032980##k, and I'll make you the best Roasted Starfish you've ever had while stranded on an island with a pirate and a monkey.

no.0: Look, we need kindling to roast the starfish. This isn't rocket science, kid. And trust me, you DON'T want to eat these raw. Tried that once. Not pretty.

1.0: Hey, you're here. Good for you. Y'know, I was probably too hard on you. I bet you could make a decent Explorer. Well, I'm sure you could, with my new weapon. Shame we're never getting off this island...\r\n#L0#Hey, that reminds me. While I was getting the #b#t4032980#, I saw a bunch of weird stuff on that small island over there. Is there anything we could use to escape?#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, right, the small island. Funny story about that. I had an #bIgnition Device#k for this #bCannon#k here, but I lost it in a storm, and I think it ended up on that little island. Shame, too...if we had it, we could get off this island. Oh, well.

item.0: Have you not found #t4032980# yet? You DO know how to perform a #bRegular Attack#k, right? Just mash #bCtrl#k a bunch!
